Class Tile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.shipboard.Tile
public class Tile extends Object
Represents a Tile entity with properties such as ID, component, orientation, connectors, locking state, and coverage state. Provides functionality for manipulating orientation, connectors, and component interactions.

  • Constructor Details

    • Tile

      public Tile()
      Constructor for the Tile class. Initializes the tile with default values: - idTile is set to 0. - Component is initialized with type SKY and level 0. - Connectors are set to FLAT for all orientations. - Tile orientation is set to NORTH. - Tile is locked by default. - Tile is uncovered by default.

    • Tile

      public Tile(int idTile, Component component)
      Constructs a new Tile instance with specified ID and component.
      Parameters:
      idTile - the unique identifier for the tile
      component - the component associated with the tile, defining its functionality

    • Tile

      public Tile(int idTile, Component component, ConnectorType c1, ConnectorType c2, ConnectorType c3, ConnectorType c4)
      Constructs a Tile with specified attributes and connectors.
      Parameters:
      idTile - the unique identifier of the tile
      component - the component associated with the tile
      c1 - the connector type at position 0
      c2 - the connector type at position 1
      c3 - the connector type at position 2
      c4 - the connector type at position 3

    • turnOn

      public void turnOn()
      Attempts to activate the component associated with this tile. If the operation is not allowed for the component type, the exception is caught, and an error message is printed to the standard output.

    • turnOff

      public void turnOff()
      Attempts to deactivate the associated component by invoking its turnOff method. If the operation is not supported for the specific component type, an error message is logged indicating the exception and component details.

    • isActive

      Checks if the current tile's component is active.

      true if the component is active, false if inactive or an error occurs.

    • setTileOrientation

      public void setTileOrientation(Orientation tileOrientation)
      Updates the orientation of the tile and rotates its connectors accordingly. The rotation is performed using the Juggling algorithm.
      Parameters:
      tileOrientation - the new orientation for the tile, represented as an Orientation enum value.

    • rotateTileClockwise

      public void rotateTileClockwise()
      Rotates the tile's orientation 90 degrees clockwise. Updates the tile's internal orientation state.

    • rotateTileCounterClockwise

      public void rotateTileCounterClockwise()
      Rotates the tile's orientation 90 degrees counterclockwise. Adjusts the orientation cyclically within the four cardinal directions. Updates the tile's orientation by calling setTileOrientation.

    • isLocked

      public boolean isLocked()
      Checks whether the tile is currently locked.
      Returns:
      true if the tile is locked, false otherwise.

    • lockTile

      public void lockTile()
      Locks the tile by setting its locked status to true. Prevents further actions that require an unlocked state.

    • uncoverTile

      public void uncoverTile()
      Uncovers the tile by setting its covered status to false. Updates the internal state indicating the tile is no longer hidden.

    • getFirePower

      public double getFirePower()
      Calculates the firepower of the tile's component, adjusting based on tile orientation. If the orientation is NORTH, the full firepower of the component is returned. For other orientations, the firepower is halved.
      Returns:
      the calculated firepower as a double value.

    • getPotentialFirePower

      public double getPotentialFirePower()
      Calculates the potential firepower of a tile based on its component level and its orientation. Firepower is higher if the tile is oriented NORTH.
      Returns:
      the potential firepower as a double. Equal to the component level if the orientation is NORTH, or half the level otherwise.

    • getEnginePower

      public int getEnginePower()
      Retrieves the engine power of the tile's associated component.
      Returns:
      the engine power of the component; 0 if the component is not of type ENGINE or DOUBLE_ENGINE.

    • generateTiles

      public static Map<Integer,Tile> generateTiles()
      Generates a map of tiles by reading configuration data from a JSON file. The configuration specifies details such as component type, level, and connectors.
      Returns:
      a map where keys are tile IDs and values are Tile objects, or null if an exception occurs

    • toString

      public String toString()
      Returns a string representation of the Tile object in a formatted structure. The format includes the Tile ID, component details, orientation, and graphical representations of connectors and component state.
